headline: Gold eases ₹49 a gram today; silver flat at ₹1,75,000 a kg
summary: Today's change is small: 24K gold fell ₹49 per gram (about 0.39%) to ₹12,508, and 22K fell ₹45 to ₹11,465, while silver held steady at ₹1,75,000 per kg. Over the last 7 days gold has dropped about 9% and silver about 10%, and within the 27 days of recorded history gold is down about 12% from ₹14,275 and silver about 20% from ₹2,20,000, with gold's recorded high on 5 November and silver's on 26 October. Possible drivers include the movement of the US dollar against the rupee and international prices, which were roughly $3,539 an ounce for gold and $41 for silver at the time of the data.
outlook: Prices have fallen sharply over the past week, so buyers may prefer to wait for a clearer trend before committing, and should compare making charges and GST across jewellers before buying.
